 Hon'Ble Mrs. Vani Ranjan Agrawal, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant application under Section 529 B.N.S.S, has been filed for directing to Civil Judge (JD)/FTC-II, Amroha to decide the Criminal Case No. 3136 of 2008(State Vs. Zakir and other)
arising out of Case Crime No. 754 of 2008, under Sections 498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act,
Police Station Amroha Dehat, District- Amroha within a period stipulated as fixed by this Hon'ble Court.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 3136 of 2008(State Vs. Zakir and other)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It has been stated by the learned counsel for the applicant that aforesaid case of the applicant is pending since 2008 and same may be decided within the stipulated time.
4. The learned A.G.A. has no objection to the submission made by the counsel for the applicant.
5. No useful purpose would be served by keeping this petition pending in view of the order, which the Court proposes to pass hereunder.

6. Without entering into the controversy involved in the aforesaid case, the application is disposed of with direction to Civil Judge (JD)/FTC-II, Amroha to decide the aforesaid case, expeditiously,
preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of the certified copy of this order,
in accordance with law provided there is no other legal impediment.

(Mrs. Vani Ranjan Agrawal,J.) November 4, 2025 Gss  Zakir vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161560086/
